successors.name: Tukulor Empire
successors.text: Diarra (Diara), the Soninke kingdom of north-western Mali east of Kaarta (the page gives no location beyond 'northwestern Mali' and the town of Diarra; the disc is the one used in the kaarta dossier…

ledger.x: 31 May 1860: the kingdom ends with the execution of its last king.

wars.name: Umar Tall conquers Diarra
wars.outcome: The last Diarra king, Biranté Karounga Diawara, was captured and executed on 31 May 1860.

wars.name: Kaarta conquers Diarra
wars.outcome: In 1754 "the Bambara kingdom of Kaarta conquered and vassalized the kingdom".

certainty.note: The page gives only 'northwestern Mali' and the town of Diarra; the disc is a stand-in.
